claim_summary: All-coupling minimum variance and stagewise-antithetic variance are given explicitly for a two-walker Green-diagonal estimator; global quantile coupling is strictly better for stopping probabilities below one half, the no-joint-revisit threshold is 1 minus one over square root of two, and the rare-stopping relative variance tends to 2 minus pi squared over six.
scientific_integrity: Self-contained analytic derivations and standard-library checks; classical countermonotonicity and published global graph-walk OT are acknowledged as prior art; no independent verification or authorship is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the unsquared Neumann Green diagonal on a two-vertex undirected edge.
Two geometrically stopped walkers with fixed marginal survival law and exact per-visit importance weights.
No general graph, nonlinear graph-kernel, wall-clock efficiency, optimal uniqueness or higher-number-of-walkers theorem.
Equivalent special-case results in less visible classical coupling literature may exist.
title: Exact coupling frontier for two-walk Green-diagonal estimation on an edge
